name: wecom-autoreply
description: Opt-in, macOS: a resident WeCom (企业微信) AI bot whose replies are written by headless, tool-less Claude Code; requests that need you become numbered to-dos pushed to your WeCom. What the owner says to the bot goes into a Claude Code terminal on the Mac (tmux + a window, with tools, one session per task, directory confirmed first), which also lists and closes the to-dos; each turn's reply is pushed back to WeCom. Includes wecom-cli setup and a launchd agent that keeps the long connection alive.
